#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

bool equal(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        if (a[i] != b[i])
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool dot(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    long long res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        res += a[i] * b[i];
    }
    return res > 0;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n <= 11) {
        vector<vector<long long>> points(n, vector<long long>(5));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; ++j) {
                cin >> points[i][j];
            }
        }

        vector<vector<vector<long long>>> vectors(
            n, vector<vector<long long>>(n, vector<long long>(5)));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 5; ++k) {
                    vectors[i][j][k] = points[j][k] - points[i][k];
                }
            }
        }

        unordered_set<int> list;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            bool flag = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    if (!equal(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) &&
                        dot(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k])) {
                        list.insert(i + 1);
                        flag = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (flag)
                    break;
            }
        }

        cout << (n - list.size()) << endl;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (list.find(i + 1) == list.end()) {
                cout << (i + 1) << endl;
            }
        }
    } else {
        cout << 0 << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
